name: M6.ActualTransfer.actual_witness_work
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualTransfer.BP) (d : ℕ) (v : M6.Pinned.Vector (2*N)) (k : ℕ), M6.ActualTransfer.span a b < N → M6.ActualTransfer.solve N a b = some (d,v,k) → M6.ActualTransfer.actualWitnessWork N a b k ≤ 200000*N^4*4^(M6.ActualTransfer.span a b)
guidance: Actual solve query bound follows by unfolding ActualTransfer.solve and Pinned.solve, splitting firstPositive, and accepted Pinned.recover_properties applied to finRange(2*N). It requires no enumerator premise. For cost targets use actual preprocess_correct_cost once accepted and generic query cost bounds; max-degree span<N gives both degree bounds, and cyclic modulus degree<=N follows natDegree_add_le and natDegree_X_pow. No free oracle/count/preprocessing premise is allowed in these final specializations. Return tactic lines without leading by.
